requirement: A widget turn or create that failed does not block the hand-off to the site's chat, and a lost create never makes a second site

oracle.ref: PR #1479 (fix); fix evidence: Review 19/10/2026: v.inflight was saved before the model call and cleared only on success; native open refused it forever and the bootstrap showed 'could not connect' on every Retry
oracle.invariant: S1: the turn answers its error; native open succeeds; the words are offered back as an unsent draft. S2: the stale one does not block; the fresh one still answers WIDGET_NATIVE_WAIT_FOR_TURN. S3: the second press re-sends the first request under the same buildId and adopts its site; one site. S4: discovery renders with its state, not the retry screen.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
productSourcesUnresolved: apps/tracy-web/src/widget/route.js:542 readFile() with a computed path

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: a turn the model failed leaves its words for review and does not block the native hand-off
a turn stored by a process that restarted mid-run blocks only while it could still be running
a create whose answer was lost is sent again as it was, under the same buildId, and adopted
a refused native hand-off at bootstrap (a turn still settling) renders discovery with its state
